# Third-party data

`denver_july_hourly_1949-1990.csv` — hourly precipitation for Denver, Colorado, July only, 1949–1990.
Extracted from the CRAN package **extRemes** 2.2-1 (dataset `Denversp`), licensed **GPL (>= 2)**; it is
redistributed here unchanged in content (reformatted to CSV) under that licence, separately from the tool's
own code licence. Original source: Katz, R. W. & Parlange, M. B. (1995) *Water Resources Research* 31(5),
1331–1341; quality assessment: Collander et al. (1993).

Caveat: the extRemes documentation states millimetres, but the record maximum (1.59 per hour) is far below
known Denver convective intensities in mm and consistent with inches. The hold-out experiment reports only
ratios and percentage errors, which do not depend on the unit.
